candidate_provenance: Recorded before commit from the current tracked worktree; source hashes below identify the candidate.

regressions_before_fix.failure: mismatched values produced an empty stored geometry instead of throwing

limits.checks: matching value count; finite XY, values and levels; workload bounds before triangulation/output allocation

numerical_changes: Remove the absolute 1e-12 midpoint fallback on nonzero value ranges.
Halve scalar operands before subtracting if their opposite-extreme difference overflows.
Convex coordinate interpolation and endpoint clamp avoid overflowing coordinate differences.
Uniformly scale finite coordinates for centroid/angle ordering to avoid sum/difference overflow.
allocation_changes: WASM dispatcher borrows stored MultiPoint coordinates instead of cloning them.
Emit LineStrings directly instead of first retaining a per-level segment vector.

api.rust: isolines now returns Result<Vec<LineString>, GeoError>; native callers must handle errors.
api.wasm: same method, arguments, output handle and Feature<MultiLineString> shape; invalid input now throws and does not store an empty result.

in_app_browser.scope: SDK dedicated/shared Worker consumption of rebuilt WASM; isolines operation correctness is verified separately against real WASM in Node.

remaining: Fan triangulation remains approximate and outputs disconnected segments; no complete contour/Delaunay/topology guarantee.
Numerically ill-conditioned geometry and scalar inputs still have floating-point precision limits.
Bounds apply to triangle-level work/output; JSON decoding and overall WASM heap peaks are outside the arena storage estimate.
No comparative isolines runtime benchmark was run; no measured speedup is claimed. Existing CI native gate covers its other 20 workloads.
